rationale: Collision between two motor vehicles with damage to the policyholder's vehicle and resulting injury to the policyholder.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan rear-ended on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15 am; vehicle totaled with trunk crushed into back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's information on file via police report. High-severity collision requiring vehicle assessment and injury documentation.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by another vehicle traveling 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: filed; other driver's insurance info available
